ns2:section.sectionText: Speculative Futures Our future is--and has always been--uncertain. In this course we'll read science fiction and speculative fiction by some of your favorite authors: Margaret Atwood, Ray Bradbury, Max Brooks and many more; consider questions of economics, environment, politics, and health; and explore some of the latest technological developments. Our primary goal is to find answers to these questions: what do our visions of the future tell us about the state of the world--historically and in the present day? What kinds of questions, ideas, and problems motivate the future? What roles does technology play in these visions? Who gets to construct our future and why?
